issue.title: SASE research-file hook: stop hash-suffixed ref stems from dodging dedupe and choose -f overwrite or -f

task_type_fields.proposal: Stop the SASE research-file hook from creating duplicate references, and give it a deliberate recapture choice. The live-vault survey in research:202610/ref_create_recapture_modes/ref_create_recapture_modes.md found five `ref/chat/*-<12 hex>.md` duplicates: the hook derives Markdown stems that include the artifact id hash, so a re-published report gets a new stem and dodges `bob ref create`'s title/stem dedupe. Possible fix (from plan:202610/ref_create_force_recapture.md, phase record): strip the artifact id when deriving the stem, then use the new recapture modes from bob-cli-c9 — `bob ref create <md> -f overwrite` while the earlier capture is still unread (ready with 0 highlights; bob already prints `hint: <stem> is still ready with 0 highlights; -f overwrite would replace it instead`), otherwise bare `-f` to add a `<root>__vN` reading. Also decide how to fold the five existing hash-suffixed duplicates (e.g. `bob ref rename` into one family or archive). Spans bob-cli (stem derivation if it lives there) and chezmoi (the hook script).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-c9 shipped the -f reread/overwrite modes the hook would use, but its plan scopes the hook change out (proposed follow-up from the record phase, bob-cli-c9.6 note 2) because it spans the chezmoi hook and needs its own design for existing duplicates.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-c9.6 note 2; five live ref/chat duplicates exist because the hook's stems embed the artifact hash, and recapture modes now give it a deliberate choice.
